children: Anterix authorized a $250.0 million share repurchase program effective Sept. 22, 2026.
Board approved repurchases of up to $250,000,000 of common stock through Sept. 22, 2029.
Repurchases may occur in open market or privately negotiated transactions, including under Rule 10b5-1 plans.
Timing and amounts depend on market conditions, capital position and strategic considerations; program is discretionary.
Program follows expiration of prior repurchase plan on Sept. 21, 2026 and may be suspended, discontinued or modified.
